intent: Group related options under one label inside a NativeSelect.
typical_uses: A named cluster of related options inside a longer NativeSelect list (regions inside a timezone picker)

dont_use_when.situation: A flat list with no natural grouping

instead.target: NativeSelect itself, with the options as its direct children

invariants.text: `label` is the name the group goes by - it is what the platform draws as the group's header inside the picker and what assistive tech announces for the group.

a11y.by: native-select.test.tsx's "groups options under an optgroup label" assertion, which queries the group by its group role and the name taken from `label`

good.title: Two groups in one select
good.code:
<NativeSelect aria-label="Timezone">
  <NativeSelectOptGroup label="Europe">
    <NativeSelectOption value="cet">Central European Time</NativeSelectOption>
  </NativeSelectOptGroup>
  <NativeSelectOptGroup label="Americas">
    <NativeSelectOption value="est">Eastern Time</NativeSelectOption>
  </NativeSelectOptGroup>
</NativeSelect>

bad.title: A lone group wrapping every option in the list
bad.why: One group for the whole list adds a header without adding structure - with nothing to distinguish it from, the group only stands between the user and the choice.
